kind: gen_input (rigid R-type WS2/WSe2 moire supercell + LAMMPS relaxation deck)
provenance: structure and deck references from 3_reproduction/L1/ (reproduced 2026-06-21; see ../../../3_reproduction/L1/index.md). Ground truth is OUR rigid cell (references/lammps.dat) and OUR as-run relaxation deck (references/lammps.in), not any paper figure or number.
note_reference: The reference structure is our rigid cell re-expressed in ELEMENT space by the 6-type Twister map above, computed inside grader.py from reference/lammps.dat. All structure targets (species counts, per-layer W counts, layer lattice constants, z-planes, anchor) are DERIVED from that reference at grade time; only the tolerances below are constants here.

structure_tolerances.note: Descriptor fallback instead of a full structure match (StructureMatcher/fallback both impractical or unsafe at 3903 atoms -- a documented exception, see notes.md). Integer counts are compared exactly; lengths/lattice per the structure standard; the metric bands below are documented exceptions justified by the designed-wrong self-check.
structure_tolerances.note_vacuum: only the in-plane lattice is compared to the reference; the vacuum height along z is the agent's choice (prompt de-leak 2026-07-08) and is guarded by the 15 A floor instead of a c match
structure_tolerances.layer_identity: exact: every chalcogen nearer the bottom W-plane is S, every one nearer the top is Se (all-or-nothing integer partition)

geometry_tolerances.note: B-01: new per-site xy bijection tolerance uses the structure standard default; all existing structure tolerances remain unchanged. B-02: both submitted formats share one rigid translation; xy uses the same 0.10 A and z reuses the existing 0.15 A half-thickness margin. Full-cell consistency uses the existing lattice tolerances.

deck.ftol_note: the prompt states the objective (a tight force criterion, energy test disabled) and withholds the number (handbook 5.2a); our as-run deck used 1e-8, and the floor accepts any competent tight choice down to 1e-6
required_checks: complete chemically correct ordinary SW per sheet and four inward-interface KC/z channels, effective type mappings
exact element counts W1301 S1352 Se1250

score: 1 only if structure, one-to-one lattice occupancy, POSCAR/data consistency and every required deck check pass. Existing whole-layer phase freedom applies to reference comparison only.
